## Changelog

- Presented Wuwa Tappo consistently across About, update dialogs, status messages, errors and project documentation.
- Simplified the up-to-date message to “Wuwa Tappo is up to date.”
- Moved original-project credit into README acknowledgements while preserving copyright and license notices.

## Instructions

- Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 13 or later. Choose CN or Global to match your account.
- Use **Settings → Check for Updates → Update and Restart**, or quit the app and replace it with the matching DMG/ZIP build.
- The updated wording appears after installing this version. Settings, counters and remembered login are retained.
- If macOS blocks launch, use **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.
- Both packages contain `Wuwa Tappo.app`; install the regions in separate folders if you keep both. `.app.tar.gz` and `.sig` files are for the in-app updater.
